scripts.build:cv: mkdir -p static/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/academic/main.typ static/cv/academic-cv.pdf && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/casual/main.typ static/cv/casual-cv.pdf
scripts.build:cv:academic: mkdir -p static/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/academic/main.typ static/cv/academic-cv.pdf
scripts.build:cv:casual: mkdir -p static/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/casual/main.typ static/cv/casual-cv.pdf
scripts.deploy: npm run build && gh-pages -d public -b gh-pages
